scenarios.name: Baseline
scenarios.description: Current roster and assumptions. 5 specialists, about 70 core sellers (Conflict: 53 on the roster), 17 architects, 6 territories.

scenarios.name: Option A: pods now
scenarios.description: Four practice pods (services, cybersecurity, networking, Microsoft) plus an Avant pod. Specialist hires toward the 1:8 line.

scenarios.name: Option B: three-person office
scenarios.description: A three-person office reporting to the CEO (Vince Ippolito, Sam Aguilar, Ryan McKee). Kurt Page becomes Director of Solutions Architecture and his principal seat is backfilled. Troy Sorrento backfills Vince’s specialist seat. Backfills only in year one.

scenarios.name: Option C: office first, then pods
scenarios.description: Option B for months 0 to 12, then Option A’s pods. Specialists 4 to 5 by month 6, +2 released at the month 12 gate (7 by month 18), +2 released at the month 18 gate (9 by month 24). Avant stays with specialists for 12 months, then moves to a dedicated desk.

scenarios.name: Buy instead of build
scenarios.description: A diagnostic, a fractional revenue leader and a benchmark subscription in place of two director hires.
